events.title: Next Fest demo build patch notes
events.summary: NewNew lighting: sun and moon with a day and night cycle, character and scenery shadows, rim light and light shafts. The world reacts to the time of day.Options: Gameplay tab with camera shake, rumble, screen effects, dialogue speed and font size, minimap opacity and language. Video tab with VSync, FPS cap and brightness. Reset per tab.Quick restart after death: hold Jump, or R on keyboard and LT+RT on gamepad.Dash now passes through bosses.Ability pickups you don't have yet now show in the HUD.

That's it!Movement cleaner than my bank account at the end of the month.Refreshing fusion of roguelike and metroidvania? Also true!Challenging for the tryhards! events.title: No-Hi Alpha is now Live!
events.summary: Discover an Unforgettable Journey - Join the Alpha of No-Hi! We're beyond excited to announce that the alpha for No-Hi is officially live on Steam! This is your chance to be one of the first players to explore and test the world we've been passionately crafting. At this early stage, we’re eager to hear your feedback and find out what we can improve. Join our community on Discord and become a part of No-Hi's development. Support our project financially, crowdfunding campaign available on Catarse.
